fields.label: Title
fields.value: Distinguishing SYN queue pressure from bandwidth saturation

fields.label: Scenario
fields.value: Monitoring shows a large number of incomplete TCP handshakes. The operations team evaluates handshake protections while checking whether the network link itself is overloaded.

fields.label: Steps
value: Measure pending handshake state and legitimate connection success
Use supported SYN-cookie or proxy/delayed-binding defenses where appropriate
Escalate to upstream filtering if the access link is saturated
Verify that normal clients can establish connections

fields.label: Caveats
value: SYN cookies do not solve volumetric link saturation.
Use only authorized monitoring and configuration changes.
